mcpServer.name: atlassian-mcp
mcpServer.description: Connects to Atlassian Jira to read project tickets

version_handling.description: Version is passed dynamically by the user at runtime

jql_templates.all_done_tickets: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" AND status = Done
jql_templates.done_stories_with_new_features_label: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" AND status = Done AND issuetype = Story AND labels = "new_features"
jql_templates.done_stories_with_enhancements_label: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" AND status = Done AND issuetype = Story AND labels = "enhancements"
jql_templates.done_stories_without_label: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" AND status = Done AND issuetype = Story AND labels is EMPTY
jql_templates.done_bugs: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" AND status = Done AND issuetype = Bug
jql_templates.done_tasks: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" AND status = Done AND issuetype = Task
jql_templates.done_epics: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" AND status = Done AND issuetype = Epic
jql_templates.all_tickets_all_statuses: project = {project_key} AND fixVersion = "{version}" ORDER BY status
